text.en: This weapon marks targets with an automated targeting system. Final blows on marked targets generate a telemetry pattern. Collecting 3 telemetry patterns without dying grants this weapon bonus damage for a long duration.

This weapon marks targets with an automated targeting system. Final blows on marked targets generate a telemetry pattern. Collecting 3 telemetry patterns without dying grants this weapon bonus damage for a long duration.

While held, this weapon searches for the closest target within 30 meters and <pve marks them through walls /> <pvp [highlights them] /> every ? seconds.

Killing marked targets spawns a 'Telemetry Pattern' at their point of death for 60 seconds, which can be physically collected to grant 1 ammo. 

Telemetry Patterns are lost on death.

Collecting 3 Telemetry Patterns grants 6 ammo and 'Langrangian Sight' for 30 seconds, which grants:
• <pve 50% /> <pvp [87.5%] /> increased damage
• 30 Handling
• 35 Reload Speed

Collecting Telemetry Patterns during Langrangian Sight's timer fully refreshes the buff.

//No catalyst entry for the API??
/*
Jump Driver:

Grants Enhanced Radar Resolution while held.

While Lagrangian Sight is active, any kill triggers the <void/>Void Implosion.

*/

This weapon searches for a <link Minor or Elite [#CombatantClassifications] /> target within 50 meters and <pve marks them through walls /> <pvp [highlights them] /> for 45 seconds. Requires a minimum of three viable targets and prioritizes the furthest target away. Cooldown of 7 seconds between marks.

Killing marked targets in any way spawns a 'Telemetry Pattern' at their point of death for 60 seconds, which can be physically collected to grant 1 ammo.

Telemetry Patterns are lost on death.

Collecting 3 Telemetry Patterns grants 6 ammo and 'Langrangian Sight' for 30 seconds, granting:
• <pve 50% /> <pvp [87.5%] /> increased damage
• 30 Handling
• 35 Reload Speed

Buff can be activated while stowed.

Collecting Telemetry Patterns during Langrangian Sight's timer fully refreshes the buff.

This weapon passively searches for <link Minor, Elite, or Player [#CombatantClassifications] /> targets within 50 meters and <pve marks them through walls /> <pvp [highlights them] /> for 45 seconds. Requires a minimum of three viable targets and prioritizes the farthest target away. Mark disappears past 80 meters. Cooldown of 7 seconds between marks.

Killing marked targets in any way spawns a 'Telemetry Pattern' at their location for 60 seconds, which can be physically collected to generate 1 ammo.

Telemetry Patterns are lost on death.

Collecting 3 Telemetry Patterns generates 6 ammo and 'Langrangian Sight' for 30 seconds, granting:
• <pve 50% /> <pvp [87.5%] /> increased damage
• 30 Handling
• 35 Reload Speed

Buff can be activated while stowed.

Collecting Telemetry Patterns during Langrangian Sight's timer fully refreshes the buff.
